verified_picks.title: PMO Analyst (JR11629)
verified_picks.reason: THE ONE REFUTATION THAT MATTERS. Link is live, posting is real, but 'stretch' does not survive. (1) LOCATION: I pulled the raw CXS record — location = 'IN KA Bengaluru', additionalLocations = None. Not a display quirk; there is no Mumbai tag on this requisition. The JD body's 'Location - Bangalore/Mumbai' is prose, the facet is the filter recruiters actually screen on. A Mumbai student who cannot relocate while enrolled at DJSCE is filtered out before qualifications are read. (2) EXPERIENCE: must-have #1 is verbatim '1-2 years of experience in a coordination, administrative, or project support role within a professional services or project-driven environment.' He has ~13 months of internships and ZERO months in professional services. Header says 'Experience - 1 to 3 Years.' (3) THE why_fit COLLAPSES IN A 30-SECOND SCREEN: the screen evidences 'organizational skills' and 'managing multiple tasks' with Vice Chairperson of Trinity and Head of Marketing at DJS S4DS — college club offices offered as proof of professional project-coordination experience. No PMO recruiter converts that. (4) TIMING: timeType=Full time, workerSubType=FTE, startDate 2026-08-10, i.e. 45 days stale on a 1-3yr req wanting a current joiner — filled by November 2026, seven months before he is free. (5) Workday itself is named in both 'Tools Used' and the good-to-have block and he has never touched it, and the screen correctly notes it is not self-learnable. Verdict: no, not stretch. Do not spend an application. Its only legitimate use is as evidence to a referrer that the PMO function hires at the junior end.

honesty_check: Mostly honest, with one real overreach and one systematic one. The honest part is verifiable and I verified it independently rather than taking its word: I queried the Workday CXS jobs API directly and the board returns 110 total postings, workerSubType facet = FTE 108 / Intern (Fixed Term)(Trainee) 1 / Contractor 1, and searchText for 'graduate', 'campus' and 'fresher' each return 0; the single intern req on the planet is 'Intern - IT & Facilities Support' in Boston (JR10760), and 'entry level' resolves to that same Boston posting plus a Senior Sales Engineer. The screen's central claim — that Quantiphi's India portal has no student lane at all — is true, and it had the discipline to mark four of its own six picks 'no'. That is rare and it deserves credit. THE OVERREACH IS JR11629. Calling PMO Analyst a 'stretch' at 68 is the one call that could actually cost him an application, and it fails on a fact the screen itself surfaced and then talked past: the raw requisition record has location = IN KA Bengaluru with additionalLocations = None. The screen flagged this in its 'gaps' prose, then scored it as if the JD's 'Bangalore/Mumbai' body text won. It doesn't — the facet is what recruiters filter on. Worse, the why_fit sells college-club offices (Vice Chairperson of Trinity, Head of Marketing at S4DS) as evidence against a must-have that reads 'within a professional services or project-driven environment.' That is flattery that dies in thirty seconds. SECOND, SYSTEMATIC PROBLEM: score inflation across the board. Four picks marked 'no' carry scores of 38, 48, 52 and 58 — high enough that a tired candidate at 11pm applies anyway. A posting he cannot enter should score in the teens, not the fifties. Same for the Resume Dropbox at 55: its own gaps field says 'realistic conversion is close to zero' while the number says 'better than half these reqs.' THIRD: the nine-item skills_to_learn list is a misallocation the screen's own conclusion contradicts. It tells him Looker Studio is the 'highest leverage item for Quantiphi specifically' because JR11629 names it twice — but JR11629 is Bengaluru-only, FTE, and will be closed by November. Learn Looker Studio and Tableau because the whole Indian BI market asks for them, not for Quantiphi. Do not learn Dialogflow CX 'for JR9904', a five-month-stale req with a 3-year floor. Net: trust the screen's structural verdict, discard its numbers, and delete JR11629 from the apply list.
final_recommendation: Spend exactly one evening here, this week, and nothing more. Tonight (by 27 Sep 2026), submit the Resume Dropbox JR467 at the verified link above — it is live, canApply=true, and tagged to Mumbai Eureka — with these two lines opening the cover letter: 'Available January-May 2027 for a full-time final-semester internship, Mumbai on-site' and 'Available for full-time employment from June 2027', followed by the phrases Quantiphi's own reqs repeat (Advanced SQL, Power BI, RAG, vector databases, multi-agent orchestration). Apply to nothing else on this portal: all five remaining picks are refuted, JR11629 included, and every one of them wants a joiner who can start in 2026. By 10 Oct, run the referral play the screen got right — LinkedIn search 'Quantiphi' + 'Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering' filtered to Mumbai, prioritise Engagement Managers and PMO/resource leads, and make the ask 'is there an intern or trainee seat for Jan-May 2027?' rather than 'refer me to a req', attaching KOP AI as the artefact. Then close the Quantiphi tab and put the real hours into the DJSCE TPO — ask them directly whether Quantiphi recruits on campus and for which cycle, because off-portal campus hiring is the only channel in which a May-2027 graduand is the intended audience, and if the TPO says no, Quantiphi is a 2028 target and not a 2026 one.
